assets.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent-background 2D soft-clay game mascot frame set. Character: the same lovable orange Lihua tabby identity used by LihuaDoku, rounded head and body, warm orange-brown stripes, cream muzzle and belly, pink inner ears, red collar, small gold paw bell. Sad but safe and adorable, eyes always visibly open with glossy pupils, ears slightly lowered, brows gently raised, paws held close, tail drooping. No horror, no injury, no black cat, no broken body, no text, no UI, no background, no full eye closure. Produce four perfectly registered full-body poses on identical 1024×1024 canvases: sad hold, tiny inhale, tear gathering, gentle sniff recovery. Keep feet, center, scale, lighting, and silhouette aligned across frames. Also produce one isolated glossy blue tear droplet overlay on a transparent canvas.
